newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ALBANIA, Feb 11 - Durres - Six vessels in port operating of which 4 discharging (1 bagged cement, 1 wheat flour, 2 nitrate). 2 Loading (1 sulphur, 1 chrome ore). 4 Vessels in roads awaiting berths (all to discharge) of which 1 rice, 1 soya beans, 1 cement, 1 wheat.

BULGARIA, Feb 3-9 - Bourgas - Ten vessels in port operating of which 6 loading (2 fertiliser, 1 salt, 1 general cargo, 1 timber, 1 coils). 2 Discharging (1 iron ore, 1 rails). 2 Discharging/loading (1 salt/general cargo, 1 sugar/metal). 8 Vessels waiting in roads, all to load, of which 1 benzene, 3 empty, 2 fertiliser, 1 chemicals, 1 coils. 18 Vessels due of which 10 to load (1 general cargo, 1 gasoil, 1 metals, 1 rolls, 1 acryl nitrate, 2 fertiliser, 1 timber, 1 clinker, 1 baryte concentrate). 8 To discharge (1 methanol, 2 iron ore, 1 sugar, 1 copper/zinc, 3 coils). Varna - 32 Vessels in port operating of which 25 loading (1 glass, 2 fertiliser, 7 soda, 1 cement, 1 sulphuric acid, 1 sas, 1 cigarettes, 1 quartz sand, 4 clinker, 1 soda/ntp, 1 cellulose, 1 kaolin, 1 edc, 1 cigarettes/tins, 1 tsp). 4 Discharging (1 sugar, 3 phosphorite). 1 Discharging/loading trucks/containers. 2 Discharging/loading containers. 12 Vessels waiting in roads of which 5 to load (1 scrap, 2 soda, 2 clinker), 7 cargo not nominate

Feb 10 - Varna - East - 3 vessels loading at berth, 4 awaiting orders. West - 6 vessels loading At berth, 2 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Lesport - 2 Vessels loading at berth. Bourgas - East - 20 Vessels due, 10 loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 8 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 4 under repair/drydock. West - 5 Vessels loading at berth.

CROATIA, Feb 10 - Rijeka - Three vessels discharging at berth, 3 loading at berth, 7 under repair/dry-docked, 3 at inoperative berth, 3 anchored, 3 due with delays expected. Split - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 under repair/dry-docked. Ploce - One vessel discharging at berth. Pula, Rasa, Zadar, Sibenik, Ploce, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, Feb 11 - Limassol - Five container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 5 conventional vessels discharging at berth, 1 vessel waiting at anchorage to discharge/load. 11 Vessels due 12/2 of which 5 containers, 2 conventional vessels, 3 passenger vessels. Larnaca - One container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth, 3 vessels due 12/2 of which 1 container, 2 conventional vessels.

ESTONIA, Feb 11 - No labour problems or delays at any port. Tallinn - City port - 3 Vessels loading at berth (2 map, 1 timber), 1 liner. 1 Vessel awaiting orders, 4 due. Kopli - 1 Fertiliser vessel loading at berth, 1 meat vessel discharging at berth, 10 vessels due. Muuga - 9 Vessels loading at berth (4 fuel oil, 1 seeds, 4 sawn timber). 1 Banana vessel discharging at berth, 1 fertiliser vessel waiting at anchage to load. Parnu - Five vessels loading at berth (2 timber, 2 peat, 1 briquettes), 9 vessels due.

ITALY, Feb 11 - Naples, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Gaeta - Two bulk carriers eta 12/2. Genoa - Commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays. 40 Vessels berthed, 5 dry-docked. Multedo - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, 5 vessels berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 6 vessels berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays, 4 vessels berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 4 vessels berthed, 5 under repair/dry-docked. Leghorn - Two vessels in roads, no delays, 41 vessels berthed. Civitavecchia - One vessel in roads. Gaeta, Salerno, Naples, Palermo, Ancona, Falconara - No vessels in roads, no delays.

Augusta - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, 2 vessels berthed. Syracuse - Oil harbour - 1 Vessel in roads, no delays, 1 vessel berthed. Sarroch - Three vessels in roads, 3 vessels berthed. Taranto - Two vessels in roads. Ravenna - Eleven vessels in roads. Venice - No vessels in roads. Trieste - No vessels in roads, slight congestion at oil terminal expected over the next few days.

LATVIA, Feb 11 - No strikes at any port. Ventspils - Nine vessels in port of which 7 operating as follows, 3 steel loaders, 1 aluminium loader, 1 general cargo loader, 1 profile loader, 1 timber loader. 2 Vessels waiting, no delays, 13 vessels due. Riga - Twelve vessels in port of which 11 operating as follows, 5 timber loaders, 1 cotton loader, 2 container loaders, 1 metal loader, 1 tanker loader, 1 fish discharger. 1 Vessel waiting, no delays, 15 vessels due. Liepaja - Eight vessels in port of which 7 operating, 1 waiting, no delays, no vessels due.

LITHUANIA, Feb 10 - Klaipeda - Vessels loading in port, 1 oil, 6 fertiliser, 1 each steel coils, steel sheets, scrap, paper, cement, containers. Discharging, 6 fish, 1 fish powder, 1 dolomite stone, 2 sugar. 1 Vessel loading/discharging, 7 in roads, 25 due.
POLAND, Feb 11 - Szczecin - 36 Vessels loading at berth, 38 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge, 9 under repair/dry-docked, 78 due.

PORTUGAL, Feb 9 - Leixoes - Vessels operating, 2 general cargo, 2 container vessels, no vessels awaiting berth, places vacant. 11 Piers with cranes, 2 piers without cranes, 1 container pier. Feb 10 - Sines - Six vessels in port operating of which 1 discharging crude oil, 5 loading (1 metallic structures, 1 butadiene, 1 gasoil, 1 gasoil/gasoline/jet fuel, 1 propane/butane). 2 Vessels waiting of which 1 to load solid sulphur, 1 awaiting owner's instructions. 13 Vessels due of which 7 to discharge (3 crude oil, 1 coal, 1 chemical naphtha, 1 metallic structures, 1 mtbe). 6 To load (2 aromatic mixture, 1 unleaded gasoline, 1 butane, 1 jet fuel, 1 propylene). Setubal - 12 Vessels in port of which 2 loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 5 under repair/dry-docked, 14 due of which 10 to discharge, 3 to load, 1 for repairs,dry-dock.

ROMANIA, Feb 11 - Constantza - 37 Vessels operating of which 17 general cargo (13 loading, 4 discharging). 6 Bulkers (3 loading, 3 discharging), 7 bagged chemicals, 2 bagged cement (all loading), 5 containers (3 loading, 2 discharging). 10 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 general cargo (2 to load, 1 to discharge), 2 bulkers, 3 bagged chemicals, 2 containers (all to load). Constantza south (Agigea) - 7 General cargo vessels loading. Mangalia - No vessels. Midia - Two livestock carriers loading.

RUSSIA - BALTIC PORTS - St. Petersburg - 10 Feb - 23 Vessels operating of which 18 loading (8 non-ferrous, 5 fertiliser, 1 steel, 3 containers, 1 coal). 5 Discharging (1 frozen metal, 2 containers, 1 rice, 1 frozen chicken). 17 Vessels awaiting operations, 13 due. Feb 11 - No strikes. Kaliningrad - 10 Vessels in port, all operating, of which 1 urea loader, 1 coal loader, 2 scrap metal loaders, 1 grain loader, 1 timber loader, 1 cocoa discharger, 1 fruit discharger, 1 wheat discharger, 1 container discharger. No vessels waiting, no delays, no vessels due. Vyborg - Five vessels in port, all operating, no vessels waiting, no delays, 1 vessel due.

FAR EASTERN PORTS - Feb 11 - no delays/strikes/congestion at any port. Vladivostok - 16 vessels in port of which 2 passenger ships, 8 loading (1 containers, 4 metal, 3 timber), 1 fish discharger, 5 vessels waiting. Nakhodka - 15 Vessels in port of which 8 loading (2 metal, 5 timber, 1 general cargo), 7 waiting. Vostochny - Six vessels in port of which 3 loading (2 timber, 1 metal). 1 Discharging/loading containers, 2 waiting. Posyet - One timber vessel loading. Zarubino - No vessels.

BLACK SEA, Feb 11 - Novorossiysk - 22 Vessels in port operating of which 15 loading (1 timber, 1 coal, 6 steel, 1 paper/zinc, 1 copper cathodes, 1 aluminium, 1 saltpetre, 1 fertiliser, 1 seeds, 1 general cargo). 7 Discharging (2 rice, 1 corn, 2 citrus, 1 bananas, 1 various). 30 Vessels waiting in roads of which 19 to load 8 steel, 2 zinc, 1 copper, 1 aluminium, 1 cellulose, 1 paper, 1 saltpetre, 1 pig-iron, 3 scrap). 11 To discharge (4 rice, 5 citrus, 1 barytes, 1 luggage). 33 Vessels due of which 24 to load (2 cement, 1 scrap, 9 steel, 1 copper cathodes, 2 copper, 2 aluminium, 3 fertiliser, 1 paper, 3 coal). 8 To discharge (2 sugar, 2 citrus, 1 machines, 1 equipment, 1 luggage, 1 other vessel), 1 to discharge/load containers. Oil terminal - 10/2 - 2 Tankers loading crude oil, 5 waiting to load crude oil, 9 tankers due to load of which 7 crude oil, 2 diesel oil.

NORTHERN BASIN, Feb 11 - Murmansk - Eight vessels operating of which 3 alumina, 1 npk, 1 scrap, 1 apatite, 1 coal, 1 anode paste, 1 alumina discharger waiting. 9 Vessels due during the week of which 6 loaders (4 apatite, 1 npk, 1 aluminium), 3 dischargers (2 alumina, 1 cabotage).

SLOVENIA, Feb 10 - Koper - 13 Vessels berthed of which 3 container vessels loading/discharging, 2 bulk carriers loading coal/soya, 2 bulk carriers discharging alumina/salt, 1 general cargo loading paper/pipes, 1 ferry loading/discharging, 1 tanker discharging gasoline, 2 reefers discharging bananas, 1 livestock loading bulls. 13 Vessels due during next 2 days of which 2 containers loading/discharging, 4 car carriers to load/discharge cars, 2 livestock vessels to load bulls, 3 general cargo to load sawn timber/steel products, 1 general cargo to discharge rice, 1 reefer to discharge bananas. No delays expected.

TURKEY, Feb 10 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - Eight vessels operating of which 4 containers, 3 dry cargo, 1 ro-ro, no berthing delays except for heavy lift cargoes. Galata - 9 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, port congested. Ambarli - 12 Vessels operating, no berthing delays.

UKRAINE, Feb 10 - Mariupol - Six vessels loading at berth of which 2 metal products, 2 sulphur, 2 fertiliser. 2 Vessels discharging at berth of which 1 ore, 1 container vessel. 4 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load of which 3 metal products, 1 sulphur, 1 sunflower seeds vessel waiting at anchorage to discharge. 11 Floating store houses (sulphur, fertiliser), 1 vessel under repair. 18 Vessels due for loading and discharging (sulphur, ore, metal products, containers, coal/lumina, general cargo). Kerch - One metal products loading at berth, 3 vessels under repair/drydock. 4 Vessels due of which 2 to load metal products, 1 to discharge ore, 1 for repair.

Berdiansk - Four vessels loading at berth of which 1 clay, 1 coal, 2 sunflower seeds. 1 Vessel due to load metal products. Mariupol - Eight vessels in port operating of which 6 loading (1 steel, 4 fertiliser, 1 slabs/titanium), 1 discharging bauxite, 1 discharging/loading containers. 4 Vessels waiting in roads, all to load, of which 1 slabs, 1 steel billets, 1 sulphur, 1 ferrous metal. 17 Vessels due of which 10 to load (5 fertiliser, 3 steel, 1 pipes, 1 coal). 3 To discharge (1 ore, 1 alumina, 1 equipment). 4 To discharge/load containers.

Odessa - 12 Vessels in port operating of which 2 loading (1 sun flower seeds, 1 oil). 3 Discharging (1 citrus, 1 bananas, 1 general cargo). 2 Under repair, 2 waiting, 3 passenger vessels. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load (2 sunflower seeds, 1 paper). 1 To discharge bananas, 1 awaiting owner's notification. 22 Vessels due of which 12 to load (6 metals, 5 sunflower seeds, 1 barley). 7 To discharge (5 citrus, 1 bananas, 1 jute). 2 To discharge/load containers, 1 cargo not nominated.

YUGOSLAVIA, Feb 11 - Bar - 14 Vessels berthed of which 7 discharging (1 humanitarian aid, 1 general cargo, 4 bananas, 1 aluminium fluoride/cryolite). 7 Loading (2 aluminium t bars, 1 pipes, 2 steel coils, 2 empty containers). 5 Ferries on the lines Bar-Bari-Bar, Bar-Koper-Bar, no delays. Zelenika, Bijela - One vessel berthed discharging gasoline, 3 non-commercial vessels operating, 2 vessels under repair.
